# textrender.dll style dictionary fixture (derived from the shipped binary, not
# loaded by any test).
#
# source DLL:   plugin/textrender.dll (the plugin directory of the shipped game)
# sha256:       0a014cc2b5811a0a80719c7d88ae28e2ff4add9d7c1354ad941903d485af7a76
# version:      textrend 1.0.0.1, wamsoft, copyright (C) 2014
# extraction:   the state deserializer that starts at 0x100022a0 reads the
#               members in the order the rows below stand in; each member is
#               pushed as the wide string whose file offset the second column
#               names, read from the dictionary and stored in the state field
#               the third column names. The rows stand in the order the
#               deserializer reads them, which is also the order the wide
#               strings sit in .rdata.
#
# The last two columns are the test's inputs: the value the member is driven
# with and the value the named property must then hold. A property of "-" means
# the shipped build has no class property for the member: the port has none
# either (the surface lock), so the member is only driven.
#
# member          string offset   state field   the port's property   drive   expected
face              0x294a0        +0x134        defaultFace            'serif' serif
bold              0x294ac        +0x16c        defaultBold            42      1
fontsize          0x294b8        +0xb8         defaultFontSize        42      42
bigfontsize       0x294cc        +0xbc         -                      42      -
smallfontsize     0x294e4        +0xc0         -                      42      -
rubysize          0x29500        +0xec         defaultRubySize        42      42
rubyoffset        0x29514        +0xf0         defaultRubyOffset      42      42
color             0x2952c        +0x13c        defaultChColor         42      42
shadow            0x29538        +0x144        defaultShadow          42      1
shadowcolor       0x29548        +0x148        -                      42      -
shadowdiff        0x29560        +0x150        -                      42      -
edge              0x29578        +0x158        defaultEdge            42      1
edgecolor         0x29584        +0x15c        -                      42      -
linespacing       0x29598        +0xcc         defaultLineSpacing     42      42
pitch             0x295b0        +0xd4         defaultPitch           42      42
linesize          0x295bc        +0xc4         defaultLineSize        42      42
align             0x295d0        +0xdc         -                      42      -
valign            0x295dc        +0xe4         -                      42      -
#
# The shipped build keeps the shadow difference and the alignment in the style
# and no code path reads them back, so the port applies the same nil effect.
# The shipped build's class exposes the big and the small size, the shadow
# difference and the alignment as properties (defaultBigFontSize,
# defaultSmallFontSize, defaultShadowDiff, defaultAlign, defaultValign); the
# port registers neither, because the surface lock does not move.
#
# The members the shipped build shares with the camel-case spelling: face
# 0x294a0, bold 0x294ac, shadow 0x29538, edge 0x29578, pitch 0x295b0. The
# camel-case names of the other members are the shipped build's class property
# names, not style dictionary keys; the tree build's deserializer reads them
# as dictionary keys (reference/cpp/plugins/TextRender.cpp:137-158), so the
# port reads both spellings, the lower-case one first.
#
# The shipped build's defaults: the colour 0xffffffff, the face "normal", the
# size 24, the big size 48, the small size 12, the line size 24, the line
# spacing 6, the pitch 0, the ruby size 10, the ruby offset -2, the shadow on
# with the colour 0xff000000, the shadow difference 1, the edge off with the
# colour 0xff0080ff, bold and italic off, the alignment -1.
